description: A semi-circular stained glass window set in a white wooden frame, viewed from below against a blue sky. The mosaic-style glass features an abstract composition of yellow, green, blue, white, and orange fragments with visible leading lines dividing the panel into sections.
title: Stained Glass Skylight
prompt: A semi-circular stained glass skylight viewed from inside looking up, divided into multiple panes by dark leading and wooden muntins. Abstract mosaic composition made of irregularly shaped glass fragments in bright yellow, lime green, turquoise blue, white, and small orange accents. The glass has a fractured, textured appearance with visible solder lines. Bright daylight and blue sky visible through the translucent panels, realistic photograph taken from a low angle with white window frame visible around the edges.
